2115435502904246611.en_summary: @StockSavvyShay thinks we are watching the start of $SPCX's profitability S-curve, with quarterly profit projected to jump from $2.8B in Q3 to over $21B by the end of 2027, nearly 8x, driven by AI compute pricing above $50 per watt annually with paybacks under a year as more high-margin capacity comes online. An image is attached.
2115435502904246611.zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 認為 $SPCX 的獲利 S 曲線正在起步，預計單季利潤將由第三季的 28 億美元升至 2027 年底的逾 210 億美元，增幅近 8 倍，動力來自每年每瓦逾 50 美元的 AI 算力定價，以及隨著更多高利潤產能上線、回本期不到一年。附上圖片。

2115435608277712955.en_summary: @OptionsHawk says $AXGN is up 20% on results and has good size in November open interest. An image is attached.
2115435608277712955.zh_summary: @OptionsHawk 表示 $AXGN 公布業績後上漲 20%，11 月合約的未平倉量相當可觀。附上圖片。

2115436391714681100.en_summary: @scottmelker posts a headline that JPMorgan $JPM, Coca-Cola $KO and Dell $DELL object to tokenized trading of their shares on OKXICE, bringing the number of objections to 33. Two images are attached.
2115436391714681100.zh_summary: @scottmelker 發布標題：摩根大通 $JPM、可口可樂 $KO 與戴爾 $DELL 反對其股份在 OKXICE 進行代幣化交易，令提出反對的公司增至 33 家。附上兩張圖片。

2115436689443213605.en_summary: @munster_gene says we are in the early stages of a multi-year Mac super cycle. $AAPL announced 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac updates with M6 chips, pricing unchanged after June increases of 18% for the MacBook and 16% for the iMac. Mac rose from 8.6% of revenue in June 2025 to 9.5% in June 2026 and grew 29% last quarter, while the Street expects 12% growth in Sep '26 and 6% in FY27 and FY28. He expects an AI-powered hardware upgrade cycle to lift Mac growth above 10% in both FY27 and FY28.
2115436689443213605.zh_summary: @munster_gene 認為目前正處於多年 Mac 超級週期的早期。$AAPL 發布搭載 M6 晶片的 14 吋 MacBook Pro 與 iMac 更新，定價維持不變，此前 6 月 MacBook 已加價 18%、iMac 加價 16%。Mac 佔營收比重由 2025 年 6 月的 8.6% 升至 2026 年 6 月的 9.5%，上季增長 29%，而市場預期 2026 年 9 月季度增長 12%，2027 及 2028 財年增長 6%。他認為 AI 驅動的硬體換機週期將令 Mac 在 2027 及 2028 財年均增長逾 10%。

2115437000329134509.en_summary: @ThetaWarrior, quoting his earlier post flagging repeat $SKHY activity ahead of 10/27 earnings, says the sweepers are cashing in this morning with a total profit of +$4,061,300.
2115437000329134509.zh_summary: @ThetaWarrior 引用自己早前提示 $SKHY 在 10 月 27 日業績前出現重複掃單的貼文，表示今早掃單者獲利了結，總利潤為 4,061,300 美元。
